perCommand.themeIdsSource: inventories/copy.json + inventories/live.json (derived URL parameters; no command spawned)
scripts/theme-checks.mjs reads the local theme source; it addresses no theme id

notMeasured.reason: templates/page.contact.liquid has no owning page record: sitemap_pages_1.xml lists only chinh-sach-bao-mat, about-us, dieu-khoan-dich-vu, frontpage, chinh-sach-doi-tra and lien-he, and /pages/contact returns HTTP 404. The copy theme 1001512581 does not contain the template: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=1001512581&view=contact silently falls back to page.liquid (identical body to /pages/lien-he, none of the template's markers such as 'Always Ready To Be Different' appear). The live theme does render it: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=contact was requested and the marker is present. Capturable only after the copy is synced.

templates/page.quote.liquid has no owning page record (/pages/quote returns HTTP 404 and sitemap_pages_1.xml has no 'quote' entry). The copy theme silently falls back to page.liquid for https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=1001512581&view=quote (the 'Yêu cầu Báo giá Thiết bị' marker is absent). The live theme renders it: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=quote was requested and returned '# Yêu cầu Báo giá Thiết bị'. Capturable only after the copy is synced.

templates/page.documents.liquid has no owning page record (no 'documents' entry in sitemap_pages_1.xml; /pages/documents is not routable). Verified renderable on the live theme only: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=documents was requested and returned the template marker 'Tài liệu Kỹ thuật & Catalogue'. Not tested against the copy because the page.* alternates are absent there (proved for contact and quote); capture requires a theme sync.

templates/page.brands.liquid has no owning page record (no 'brands' entry in sitemap_pages_1.xml). Verified renderable on the live theme only: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=brands was requested and returned the template markers 'Tìm theo bảng chữ cái' and 'Danh mục thương hiệu'. The host route is arbitrary because the template owns no page; the copy needs a theme sync.

templates/page.stores.liquid has no owning page record (no 'stores' entry in sitemap_pages_1.xml).
